_comment: Known contextual events for the Recife traffic profile, given to the LLM-as-a-Judge (events within +-6 months of an anomaly). Deliberately minimal (federal traffic laws, changes of municipal administration, events that changed traffic in the city): it is meant to be extended with `main.py suggest-events` and checked by a steward. 'status' is verified, suggested or rejected.

events.label: Lei Seca: zero tolerance for alcohol at the wheel, with heavier penalties
Change of municipal administration in Recife
events.source: Posse do prefeito João da Costa, 01/01/2009

events.label: New Lei Seca: stricter evidence rules for drunk driving and a higher fine
Change of municipal administration in Recife
FIFA World Cup matches in the Recife metropolitan area (Arena Pernambuco)
events.source: Copa do Mundo FIFA de 2014, jogos em junho de 2014

events.label: Traffic Code amendment in force: higher fine values and new infractions
events.source: Lei 13.281, de 04/05/2016, em vigor a partir de 01/11/2016

events.label: COVID-19 pandemic declared; public-health emergency measures in Brazil
Change of municipal administration in Recife
Traffic Code amendment in force: new points system, licence validity and penalties
events.source: Lei 14.071, de 13/10/2020, em vigor a partir de 12/04/2021
